name: Thrusters and dynamic positioning (DP) systems
description: Azimuth or tunnel thrusters and the DP control system hold a floater on station, classed DP1/DP2/DP3 by redundancy. On production units DP supplements or replaces mooring.

gaps.what: Thruster rating, DP class and station-keeping capability
gaps.why: No page read gives thruster rating or a DP capability plot for an offshore unit.
gaps.next_action: Fetch a DP capability plot or thruster datasheet and record rating, DP class and capability

notes: Created 2026-11-27 in the offshore-platform component sweep (item from the platform structure taxonomy). No page read yet for this class, so the gap names the parameter and where to look; Wikipedia is cited only as secondary context.
